content:
maria: Ran the attention kernel seq-len + batch sweeps across A100 / H100 / L40S this AM. Uploading quick table and notes.

raj: Nice. Which kernel variants did you include (FlashAttention / paged / fused)?

maria: I ran flashattn-v1, flashattn-v2, fused-attn, and our paged attention fallback. Benchmark command: `./bench_attn --model=7B --gpu=$GPU --seq=$SEQ --batch=$B --kernels=all --kv=paged,none`

maria: Raw summary (tokens/s, p95 latency ms, VRAM%):
```
GPU   seq   batch  tokens/s  p95_ms  VRAM%
A100  128   8      420000    6.2     78
A100  512   4      180000    12.8    92  (paged avoids OOM)
H100  128   8      560000    5.1     65  (fused fastest here)
H100  512   4      210000    13.5    86  (flashv2 slightly better than fused)
H100  1024  2      95000     27.4    98  (paged+kv required)
L40S  256   8      320000    8.7     80  (quantized-friendly)
```

simon: Interesting that H100 fused is best at 128 but not at 512. Any profiling info? :eyes:

maria: Grabbed Nsight traces and a small perf counters dump. Key findings:
- fused-attn shows lower SM utilization at seq>=512 on H100 (launch overhead + divergent control flow).
- flashattn-v2 uses more shared memory but sustains higher occupancy for medium seq.
- paged attention reduces peak VRAM by ~15% but shifts work to CPU pinned copies during KV page-in.

raj: Did you see any kernel-specific regressions vs last week's run? We had a regression flagged on fused-attn for H100 seq=512 in the canary run.

perf-bot: Regression alert: fused-attn@H100 seq=512 throughput down 18% vs baseline (1757120000). See perf-report link: https://perf/reports/1757xx

maria: Yep saw that. Root cause looks like a shared-memory bank-conflict pattern triggered by our new block dim change. Repro snippet from tracer:
```
Kernel: fused_attn_sm80
blockDim: (128,1,1)
shared_bytes: 49152
stall_reason: shared_bank_conflict
```
Rerun with blockDim=(64,2,1) and fused-attn picks up ~12% back.

tyler: Good call. Can we add a small heuristic in kernel selector: if gpu==H100 && seq in [256,512] prefer flashv2 unless fused with tuned blockDim?

maria: Implemented a short-term rule in the selector prototype: `if gpu==H100 and seq >=256 and seq <=512 and batch <=8 -> prefer flashv2`. Reran quick sweep:
```
H100 512 4 flashv2 tokens/s 230000 p95 12.1 VRAM 84%
H100 512 4 fused  tokens/s 195000 p95 14.8 VRAM 86%
```

simon: Nice. Also saw KV cache behavior: paged mode avoids OOM at seq 1024 but increases p95 by ~20% due to host copies. We should expose cache prefetch cutoff in the console.

maria: Agreed — action: add prefetch window param to console and an autosuggest that enables paged KV when predicted VRAM>90%.

tyler: Can we add a longer 8h stability run for H100 fused-attn with tuned blockDim before shipping? Want to catch any memory growth.

maria: Scheduling it now. I'll drop the full Nsight traces and the updated kernel selector patch in the bench run thread.

raj: Thanks — this gives us concrete selector rules + follow-ups. :thumbsup:
